summary: Norris starts from pole but braces for Mercedes assault after Russell's dominant sprint victory at Zandvoort, where the defending champion admits other teams have closed the gap. Russell's start-to-finish sprint win signals Mercedes poses the primary threat to McLaren's front-row lockout, setting up a fierce battle between the two constructors fighting for championship momentum. A Norris victory would extend McLaren's lead in the standings, while a Russell triumph would inject fresh urgency into Mercedes' title push with limited races remaining.
